title: ForceFlow: Learning to Feel and Act via Contact-Driven Flow Matching
abstract: arXiv:2605.11048v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Existing imitation learning methods enable robots to interact autonomously with the physical environment. However, contact-rich manipulation tasks remain a significant challenge due to complex contact dynamics that demand high-precision force feedback and control. Although recent efforts have attempted to integrate force/torque sensing into policies, how to build a simple yet effective framework that achieves robust generalization under multimodal observations remains an open question. translated_title: ForceFlow：通过接触驱动的流匹配学习感知与行动
translated_abstract: 现有的模仿学习方法使机器人能够自主地与物理环境交互。然而，由于复杂的接触动力学要求高精度的力反馈和控制，接触丰富的操作任务仍然是一个重大挑战。尽管最近的努力尝试将力/力矩传感集成到策略中，但如何构建一个简单而有效的框架，在多模态观测下实现稳健的泛化，仍然是一个开放问题。在本文中，我们提出了ForceFlow，一个基于流匹配的力感知反应式框架。对于接触阶段策略设计，我们研究了力信号融合机制，并采用了一种不对称的多模态融合架构，将力视为全局调节信号，结合联合预测范式，增强了策略对瞬时力和历史信息的理解，从而实现力的深度耦合。
tldr: 本文提出ForceFlow框架，通过不对称多模态融合和流匹配技术，将力信号作为全局调节信号，实现接触丰富操作中的高精度力感知与稳健泛化。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ForceFlow, a force-aware framework using asymmetric multimodal fusion and flow matching to treat force as a global regulatory signal, achieving high-precision force perception and robust generalization in contact-rich manipulation.
